301:     private static bool TryParseFormat(string[] args, out string format, out string error)
302:     {

306:         for (var index = 0; index < args.Length; index++)

308:             if (!string.Equals(args[index], "--format", StringComparison.Ordinal))

310:                 error = $"Unknown argument '{args[index]}'.";

314:             if (index + 1 >= args.Length || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(args[++index]))

322:             {
323:                 error = "--format must be markdown or json.";
324:                 return false;
325:             }
326:         }
327:
